questions.stem:
—______ you ever ______ to the Shenzhen Science Museum?
—Yes, I ______ there with my classmates last month.
questions.explanation: 第一空根据ever（曾经）可知用现在完成时，have been to表示"去过某地已返回"，have gone to表示"去了某地未回"，答句说上个月和同学去的，说明已返回，故用have been；第二空根据last month（上个月，一般过去时标志词）用went。A、D第一空用助动词Did，后面动词应用原形go，且与ever不搭配；C选项have gone表示人还没回来，与答句逻辑矛盾。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ I borrowed from the library yesterday is about environmental protection.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词。先行词是the book（指物），在从句中作宾语，应用which或that。who/whom指人；whose表示"……的"，表所属关系。解题技巧：一看先行词是人还是物，二看关系词在从句中充当什么成分。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old newspapers ______ to make paper bags by the students every week.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语newspapers（报纸）是动作use的承受者，应用被动语态（be+过去分词）；时间状语every week（每周）表示经常性动作，用一般现在时；主语是复数，be动词用are。D选项were used是一般过去时被动，与every week不符；B、C是主动语态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Do you know ______?
—I'm not sure. It ______ be cloudy or rainy tomorrow.
options: A. what will the weather be like; must
B. what the weather will be like; might
C. how will the weather be; can
D. how the weather will be; must
questions.explanation: 第一空考查宾语从句语序，必须用陈述语序（主语+谓语），即what the weather will be like或how the weather will be，排除A、C（疑问语序）；第二空根据I'm not sure（不确定）可知是可能性推测，might表示"可能"，must表示"一定"（肯定推测），can表推测通常用于否定句和疑问句。因此选B。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: It is ______ (possible) for humans to live on Mars without special equipment because there is no air there.
questions.explanation: 根据句意"火星上没有空气"可知"没有特殊设备人类无法生存"，应用possible的否定形式impossible（不可能的）。im-是常见否定前缀。C、D词性错误（此处需形容词作表语，而非副词）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should ______ the lights when we leave the classroom to save electricity.
questions.explanation: turn off关闭（电器、水源等）；put up张贴、搭建；take off起飞、脱下（衣服）；set up建立。根据save electricity（省电）可知是"关灯"。解题技巧：积累常见动词短语，注意off/up/down等副词改变动词含义。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The air in the countryside is much fresher than that in the city because there are fewer cars and factories to ______ pollution.
questions.explanation: produce产生；protect保护；prevent阻止；provide提供。根据常识，汽车和工厂"产生"污染，导致城市空气不如乡村新鲜。通过上下文逻辑（因果关系）判断词义。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 根据下文"But after a few weeks, it became a habit for everyone（但几周后成了习惯）"可知，起初觉得"困难"，形成转折对比。A（容易的）与后文逻辑矛盾；C（有趣的）、D（必要的）不符合语境。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Our school started a "Green Campus" project last semester. The goal was to make our school more environmentally friendly. As members of the environmental club, my classmates and I took part in many activities.

First, we set up recycling bins in every classroom. We labeled them clearly for paper, plastic, and metal. At first, some students found it (8)______ to remember which bin to use. But after a few weeks, it became a habit for everyone.

Next, we worked on saving energy. We made posters to remind students to (9)______ the lights and computers when leaving. The teachers also joined us. They promised to use less paper by writing on both sides.

The most challenging part was the "Zero Waste Lunch" week. We asked students to bring reusable lunch boxes (10)______ of disposable ones. Many parents supported this idea. They said it was healthier for their children too.

By the end of the term, we had collected over 500 kilos of recyclables. The principal praised our (11)______ during the school meeting. He said we had made a real difference to our school environment.

This project taught us that small actions can (12)______ big changes. I feel proud to be part of this green movement.

questions.explanation: turn off关闭；turn on打开；turn up调大（音量）；turn down调小（音量）。根据saving energy（节约能源）和when leaving（离开时）可知是"关闭"灯和电脑。

questions.stem: According to the passage, urban gardens help reduce ______.
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第三段第一句"Besides cleaning the air, urban gardens also help reduce the 'heat island effect.'"可知，城市花园有助于减少"热岛效应"。解题技巧：通过题干关键词reduce定位原文，找到对应句子即可得出答案。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Urban gardens are becoming popular in big cities around the world. These green spaces are not just beautiful to look at—they actually help improve city life in many ways.

Scientists have found that plants can clean the air by absorbing (吸收) harmful gases and releasing oxygen. In crowded cities where there are many cars and factories, this is especially important. A study shows that one square meter of grass can produce enough oxygen for one person every day.

Besides cleaning the air, urban gardens also help reduce the "heat island effect." This happens when cities become much hotter than nearby countryside because of concrete (混凝土) buildings and roads. Plants provide shade and release water vapor (水蒸气) into the air, which cools down the temperature.

Furthermore, these gardens offer great educational opportunities. Schools often take students to community gardens to learn about biology and environmental science. Children can see how vegetables grow and understand where their food comes from.

However, creating urban gardens is not always easy. Space is limited in cities, and land can be expensive. Some people also worry about the cost of maintaining these gardens. Despite these challenges, many cities continue to support urban gardening projects because of their long-term benefits.

questions.stem: The underlined word 'absorbing' in Paragraph 2 probably means ______.
questions.explanation: 词义猜测题。根据第二段"plants can clean the air by absorbing harmful gases and releasing oxygen"，由and连接并列动作，与releasing（释放）相对的是"吸收"，因此absorbing意为taking in（吸收）。B（释放）是反义词；C（推开）、D（调小）不符合语境。解题技巧：利用并列结构、对比关系或定义解释猜测词义。

questions.stem: What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. Urban gardens are more important than parks.
B. All cities should replace roads with gardens.
C. Urban gardens have both advantages and challenges.
D. Children learn better in gardens than in classrooms.
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。文章前四段介绍了城市花园的好处（净化空气、减少热岛效应、教育机会），最后一段提到挑战（空间有限、土地昂贵、维护成本），因此可推断城市花园既有优点也有挑战。A、B、D选项都过于绝对（more important, all, better than），且文中没有相关比较。解题技巧：推理题必须基于原文信息，不能过度推断，排除绝对化选项。

options: A. How to Build a Garden
B. The Benefits of Urban Gardens
C. Plants and Animals in Cities
D. Why Cities Are So Hot
questions.explanation: 主旨大意题。全文围绕城市花园展开，重点介绍了它们带来的各种好处（清洁空气、降温、教育等），尽管提到挑战，但重心在益处。A选项太窄（不只讲建造）；C选项错误（未提及动物）；D选项只是文章一个细节（热岛效应）。解题技巧：最佳标题应涵盖全文主要内容，具有概括性，通常是高频出现的主题词+核心内容。

questions.explanation: 前文提到"制定时间表，写下所有作业和课外活动"，后文说"这样你就能清楚看到有多少空闲时间"。B选项"然后，清楚标记每项任务所需时间"承上启下，then表示步骤递进，mark the time与后文see...free time呼应。
questions.label: 短文填空
questions.group_passage:
As a middle school student, I know how hard it can be to balance study and hobbies. Here are some tips that have helped me.

First, make a schedule. Write down all your homework and after-school activities. (17)______ This way, you can see exactly how much free time you have for hobbies.

Second, choose hobbies that don't take too much time. For example, reading for 30 minutes before bed is better than playing video games for three hours. (18)______ You can still enjoy yourself without wasting time.

Third, use your weekends wisely. (19)______ On Sunday afternoon, you can spend time on your favorite activities like painting or playing basketball.

Finally, remember that hobbies are important too. They help you relax and develop new skills. (20)______ Finding the right balance will make your school life more colorful.

options: A. However, you should never let hobbies affect your grades.
B. Then, mark the time needed for each task clearly.
C. For instance, finish all your homework on Saturday morning.
